'''Raimu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Raimu appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a gear vendor for one of the Jedi classes. She was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, she remains in the game, as her character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
